svg.title: Zip-tie hole placement
svg.desc: Two top views of the one-sided puller, before left and after right, the plug end at the top. Left: the defaults, a 25 mm wide plug in teal. Right: zip-tie hole placement set to Manual. Marked in red: 1, the zip-tie holes, the wall notch and the seat: the four small holes beside the pocket; the notch in the top edge; the round recess at the plug end. 2, the wing openings: the two openings beside the pocket. 3, the zip-tie holes: the four small holes beside the pocket.
